question: By what factor was the α-terpineol percentage of the light fraction raised over the niaouli oil residue?
question_long: By what factor did molecular distillation raise the α-terpineol percentage of the light fraction over the niaouli oil residue?
rendered:
The α-terpineol percentage of the niaouli oil residue (NOR) was 36.52%. The α-terpineol percentage of the light fraction (LF) was 66.10%. 

To find the factor by which the α-terpineol percentage was raised, we divide the α-terpineol percentage of the LF by the α-terpineol percentage of the NOR:

66.10 / 36.52 = 1.81
